source.notes: Complete discussion from the user-designated local transcript inputs/fromm-1958/transcript.txt (1958-05-25). Wallace recast as Krusty; network announcements, nonverbal stage directions, and obsolete next-week promotion omitted. Minor transcription spacing/typo corrections recorded in edit-map.json. Historical assertions remain in their 1958 context. Two late transcript slips are corrected against transcription of the original recording: twenty or thirty years; a mass man. The initial synthesis dialogue is retained in synthesis-script.json. disclosure: Unofficial fan parody. AI animation and recreated Krusty and Erich Fromm voices. Based on the May 25, 1958 Mike Wallace interview; host recast and broadcast framing edited. Not authentic archival audio.

turns.text: Our guest is Dr. Erich Fromm, a psychoanalyst and social critic, who is internationally renowned for his studies of men and their search for freedom. Dr. Fromm, first let me ask you this. The United States, I think you will agree, has been criticized in many different quarters as a materialistic society, perhaps even a shallow society. Yet only recently, you said this...
